title: HumaninFinder: homology-first location and annotation of Humanin and SHLP1-6
description: Locates Humanin and SHLP1-6 by their position in MT-RNR2 (multi-clade vertebrate profiles) in mitogenomes, contigs and nuclear assemblies, and reports each species' own reading frame with explicit in silico evidence.
notes: Beta release accompanying a manuscript in preparation.
